# The benchmarks of the suite "packages" of .github/elide/codspeed-bench: one line per benchmark file
# in this folder, followed by its harness arguments in the form of upstream's
# mx.graalpython/mx_graalpython_bench_param.py (-i iterations, then the workload arguments).
#
# The workload argument is part of the benchmark's name on CodSpeed and selects the expected result
# in the benchmark file (EXPECTED); a change of it starts a new history there. The iteration count is
# not part of the name. The first half of the iterations is warm-up.
#
# name                  harness arguments
pydantic-json           -i 30 8000
pydantic-models         -i 30 10000
orjson-roundtrip        -i 30 10000
pandas-csv              -i 30 200000
pandas-str              -i 30 60000
pandas-groupby-merge    -i 30 600000
pandas-apply            -i 30 20000
numpy-small-ops         -i 30 600
numpy-vectorized        -i 30 4000000
lxml-xpath              -i 30 10000
